Tom/Ava — quick technical checklist from security/ops: 

- Confirmed artifact classes to remove: prompt-inputs (s3://redwood/prompt-archive/AUR-319/*), model-outputs (s3://redwood/outputs/AUR-319/*), prompt-output logs (kinesis stream shard aur-319-*), and KV-store entries with keys matching aur-319-*.
- Retention caveat: system-level audit logs (append-only) are covered by our policy; we can provide a redacted export if Aurora needs an audit trail before deletion.

- Ops run: we will run the redaction job on a dedicated node group to avoid cross-job cache contamination. Expected wall time: 3–6 hours; we add a 24-hour verification window to validate that cache misses have propagated and no residual keys remain.
